instruction: A candid outdoor photograph in a full shot captures an elderly couple walking along a park path lined with trees. On the left, the man in the light blue shirt (R1) walks forward in light blue jeans and grey sneakers, looking towards his partner with a warm smile. On the right, the woman in the grey blazer (R2) walks beside him in cream trousers and a light scarf, gesturing with her left hand as she speaks. She holds his left arm with her right hand as they stroll together. The background shows soft-focus green foliage. The scene is illuminated by soft, natural daylight, creating a warm and peaceful atmosphere.
